## .Large[.center[Commands to work with server]]


### Login

`ssh user@server`

### Copy from local computer to server

`cp ~/Folder/File user@server:/home/folder/`

`rsync -avP --progress ~/Folder/File user@server:/home/folder/`

### Copy from server to local computer

`cp user@server:/home/folder/ ~/Folder/File`

`rsync -avP --progress user@server:/home/folder/ ~/Folder/File`

---

## .Large[.center[Commands to work with `Docker`]]

### List `docker` containers

`docker ls`

### List `docker` images

`docker image ls`


### Copy from `docker` to locak computer

`docker cp <containerId>:/file/path/within/container /host/path/target`
